cpvphelper.config.title: CPvPHelper
cpvphelper.option.totem.enabled.tooltip: Puts a totem into the offhand as soon as it is empty.
cpvphelper.option.totem.replace.tooltip: Also replaces a non-totem item held in the offhand. When off, only an empty offhand is refilled.
cpvphelper.option.totem.hotbar.tooltip: Takes a totem from the hotbar with the vanilla swap-hands action: selects its slot, swaps, selects the old slot again. No inventory clicks and no movement stop.
cpvphelper.option.totem.inventory.toolti: Without a hotbar totem: releases the movement keys like opening the inventory does, swaps the totem into the offhand and closes the inventory. Your velocity is never changed.
cpvphelper.option.totem.in_air.tooltip: In the air the keys are released as well, but momentum is kept, so you don't stop mid-air. Off: the inventory swap waits for landing.
cpvphelper.option.totem.stop_ticks.toolt: How many ticks the movement keys stay released before the inventory click. 1 tick is enough.
cpvphelper.option.totem.delay.tooltip: Reaction delay after the offhand becomes empty. 0 = instant.
cpvphelper.option.totem.random_delay.too: Adds 0 to N random ticks on top of the delay.
cpvphelper.option.anchor.enabled.tooltip: Right click a block with a sword: places a respawn anchor, charges it with glowstone, switches back to the sword and detonates it. Anchor and glowstone must be in the hotbar.
cpvphelper.option.anchor.only_ground.too: Only works while you are standing on the ground.
cpvphelper.option.anchor.charge_delay.to: Ticks between placing the anchor and charging it. 0 = same tick.
cpvphelper.option.anchor.explode_delay.t: Ticks between charging the anchor and detonating it. 0 = same tick.
cpvphelper.option.anchor.explode.tooltip: Detonate the anchor with the sword. When off, it is only placed and charged, then the sword is selected again.
cpvphelper.option.stun_slam.enabled.tool: Left click an entity with an axe: after the axe hit the mace from the hotbar hits the same target, then the axe is selected again. The axe knocks out the shield, the mace smash lands right after. A Density mace is picked first.
cpvphelper.option.stun_slam.only_falling: Only when the mace hit is a smash attack: you fall more than 1.5 blocks and are not gliding. Off: every axe hit on an entity is followed by a mace hit.
Only when the target is blocking with a shield at the moment of the axe hit.
cpvphelper.option.stun_slam.delay.toolti: Ticks between the axe hit and the mace hit. 0 = same tick. With a delay the target must still be under the crosshair.
cpvphelper.option.spear_swap.enabled.too: Attribute swap on its bind (Binds, any key or mouse button): selects the hotbar spear, jabs, and selects your item again in the same tick. Works with any held item. A Lunge spear pushes you forward; the highest Lunge level is picked first.
cpvphelper.option.spear_swap.hold.toolti: Holding the key keeps jabbing every time the attack is charged. Off: one jab per key press.
cpvphelper.option.spear_swap.repeat_dela: Extra ticks between two jabs while the key is held. 0 = as soon as the attack is charged.
cpvphelper.option.trigger.enabled.toolti: Attacks the entity under the crosshair on the first frame the hit is ready, not on the next tick. Every hit is a regular left click with all vanilla click checks; blocks in front of the target hide it.
cpvphelper.option.trigger.players_only.t: Only attacks players. Off: mobs are attacked as well.
cpvphelper.option.trigger.weapon_only.to: Only with a sword, axe, mace, spear or trident in the main hand.
cpvphelper.option.trigger.charge.tooltip: Lowest attack charge for a hit. Every hit rolls its threshold between this value and 100%. Critical hits need more than 90%.
cpvphelper.option.trigger.delay_min.tool: Shortest delay between the hit becoming ready and the attack. Every hit rolls a delay between min and max, values near the middle more often.
cpvphelper.option.trigger.delay_max.tool: Longest delay between the hit becoming ready and the attack. Min and max both 0 = the very same frame.
cpvphelper.option.trigger.crit_wait.tool: In a jump a ready hit waits for the fall that makes it critical, at most this many ticks. Not when the server sees you sprinting: a sprint hit is never critical. 0 = hit right away, also on the way up.
cpvphelper.option.trigger.sprint_wait.to: During a w-tap or s-tap a ready hit waits until the sprint reaches the server again, at most this many ticks, so the hit knocks back like a sprint hit. 0 = never wait.
cpvphelper.option.jump_reset.enabled.too: When a hit knocks you back while you stand on the ground, jumps in the very tick the knockback is applied. Perfect jump reset timing.
cpvphelper.option.jump_reset.while_using: Also jump reset while eating or blocking.
cpvphelper.option.jump_reset.chance.tool: Chance that a knockback gets a jump reset.
cpvphelper.binds.title: Binds
cpvphelper.option.binds.tooltip: Keys for TriggerBot, SprintReset, JumpReset and SpearSwap: any key or mouse button, toggle or hold.
cpvphelper.bind.tooltip: Click, then press any key or mouse button. Backspace or Delete clears the bind. Without a bind the feature works whenever it is enabled.
cpvphelper.bind.mode.tooltip: Toggle: a press switches the feature on and off. Hold: an enabled feature works only while the key is held.
cpvphelper.option.trigger.reach.tooltip: Longest distance from your eyes to the hit point on the target. Never more than the vanilla reach.
cpvphelper.option.sprint_reset.enabled.t: After a sprint hit on an entity, releases the forward key for a moment so the sprint starts again for the next hit (w-tap). Needs the sprint key held or toggle sprint.
Presses the back key instead of only releasing the forward key: more distance to the target.
cpvphelper.option.sprint_reset.delay.too: Ticks between the hit and the tap. 0 = the next movement tick.
cpvphelper.option.sprint_reset.ticks.too: How many ticks the forward key stays released (or the back key pressed). 1 tick is enough to reset the sprint.
cpvphelper.option.auto_cart.enabled.tool: While your arrow flies, predicts where it lands and places a rail and a TNT minecart there, then lights the cart with flint and steel. Rail, TNT minecart and flint and steel must be in the hotbar. The bow shot bind (Binds) draws the hotbar bow and shoots.
cpvphelper.option.auto_cart.powered_rail: Places a powered rail instead of a regular rail.
cpvphelper.option.auto_cart.ignite.toolt: Lights the cart with flint and steel from the hotbar. The cart must be within entity reach (3 blocks). Off: only the rail and the cart are placed.
cpvphelper.option.auto_cart.restock.tool: When the hotbar TNT minecart slot runs out, swaps in carts from the inventory.
cpvphelper.option.auto_cart.range.toolti: Longest distance from your eyes to the rail. Never more than the vanilla block reach.
cpvphelper.option.auto_cart.delay.toolti: Ticks between rail, cart and ignition. 0 = rail and cart in the same tick.
cpvphelper.option.auto_cart.bow_charge.t: How many ticks the bow of the shot bind is drawn. 20 ticks = full power.
cpvphelper.option.trigger.reach_min.tool: Shortest distance from your eyes to the hit point on the target: closer targets are not attacked. Together with Max Distance it sets the range the bot hits in. 0 = no lower limit.
